name: S-seeded products — S4 Workcell
description: Whole-first wave-1 corpus artifact for the Workcell product corpus, seeded from the essay's S4 record (L4 Phenomenological / L1′ Phenomenal; movement 41 of §5). The whole path is S4's own movement structure #0 → #5→0, read from the authored bytes at Antykathera-Essay-Work 7d96ada2. Each scene binds the S4 record (path + sha256) and one material record from the frozen P1-census-workcell inventory (6 of 30 records; every bound record byte-identical to EpiLogos/Workcell origin/main d911bfd95, verified 2026-09-21). Admission: the S register (T25 census, register episteme). Scene texts compress and quote the records, never invent claims; tints, formations and layout are declared craft (profiles/s-products-corpus-base). Wave-1 slice, not corpus-complete.

scenes.name: A Life is somewhere
scenes.character: Workcell is situated existence: a host, filesystem, network, runtime or room matters because it changes what can be encountered and what can actually happen.

text.title: A Life is somewhere
text.italic: Workcell is situated existence: where a Life is changes what can happen.

scenes.name: L4 Phenomenological — thrown into a world
scenes.character: Being, Thrownness, Being-there, Temporality, Care, Releasement: thrownness names inherited circumstance — machine, permissions, history — that was not wholly self-authored.

text.title: L4 Phenomenological — thrown into a world

scenes.name: L1′ Phenomenal — the aperture of encounter
scenes.character: Introversion, Sensation, Feeling, Thinking, Intuition, Extroversion: input channels, telemetry and local state organise an aperture; that does not establish that sensation is phenomenally present.

text.title: L1′ Phenomenal — the aperture of encounter

scenes.name: Demand, offer and realised world
scenes.character: ExecutionDemand, BindingGraph, MaterialisationPlan, MaterialisedExecutionWorld: a desired capability does not imply that the world can presently sustain it; the material field answers.

scenes.name: Availability to others
scenes.character: Reachability does not grant permission; exposure does not abolish alterity — who can enter this space, what can leave it and what evidence may be retained help constitute the situation.

scenes.name: Material evidence returns to meaning
scenes.character: A timeout, unavailable dependency or human interruption must be able to alter the next act; a log that leaves the governing assumptions untouched has not completed the return.
